# normpatch {-}

*Patch the bias. Keep the biology.*


`r pkg("normpatch")` is an R package for estimating normalization factors from bulk RNA-seq count data.
It implements methods based on the DEGES framework,
the DEG elimination strategy,
which iteratively reduces the influence of DEGs
when estimating sample-specific scaling factors [@TbT; @TCC].
The framework is intended for datasets affected by compositional imbalance
or strongly asymmetric DEG patterns,
where standard normalization assumptions may not hold.

`r pkg("normpatch")` is a lightweight successor to the normalization components of the
`r pkg("TCC", "bioc")` package [@TCC].
Whereas `r pkg("TCC", "bioc")` provides an integrated workflow
for normalization and DEG analysis,
`r pkg("normpatch")` focuses on normalization factor estimation
and delegates downstream DEG testing to established tools
such as `r pkg("edgeR", "bioc")` [@edgeRv4] and `r pkg("DESeq2", "bioc")` [@DESeq2].
This narrower scope provides a smaller, more transparent,
and more interoperable interface.
